description:
Search the web and read the top pages in one step: returns the top web results plus the full visible text of the top 1-3 pages, each rendered in a real browser. Results that can't be read are skipped for the next one down. Optional filters: freshness (past hour to past year), include_domains / exclude_domains (up to 5 sites each), type "news". The fastest way to answer a question from fresh sources.

$0.005 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

When to use: You have a question and want it answered from current sources in one call: it searches, then reads the top pages for you.
Use instead: web_search when the snippets are enough or you want to choose which pages to read (then read_pages).
Parameters: query is required. num: how many pages to read, 1-3, default 3. Same freshness, include_domains, exclude_domains, type and country filters as web_search.
Returns: the ranked results, plus the full text (up to 12,000 characters each) of the top 1-3 pages that could be read.

country.description: Two-letter country code for local results, e.g. "us".

freshness.description: Only results from the past hour, day, week, month or year.

include_domains.description: Only results from these sites, e.g. ["reuters.com"].

num.description: How many pages to read (1-3, default 3).

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

type.description: "news" searches news articles instead of the whole web.

name: search_and_read
title: Search and read
